title: FeePolicyRef
description: An opaque reference to a commercial fee policy that ONLY the operator resolves (ADR-021). The protocol transports the reference and never knows the rule behind it. It is a string handle (operator-defined namespace), never a percentage, table, or formula.

ref.description: Opaque operator-defined policy handle (e.g. 'pol_donation_standard'). The protocol does not interpret it.
